args.note: All evidence gathered. Findings: (1) "Double charge" on 2026-09-14 is NOT a duplicate charge - TX-9002 was an authorization that timed out on capture (gateway_event=capture_timeout) and was released 2026-09-18 with no funds captured; TX-9001 is the actual settled payment for INV-2609 ($149). Per POL-B-AUTH, a released authorization is not a charge and is not refundable. SUP-5601 agent (S-22) incorrectly diagnosed this as a duplicate charge and promised a $149 refund without billing review, violating POL-B-REF (support agents may not promise refunds before billing review). SUP-5602 (S-05) correctly paused the refund pending investigation - this was right. (2) Deep Time Analytics $30 add-on (INV-2609-AO) is legitimate: added 2026-09-12 by U-2 (admin seat), permitted under POL-B-ADD (owner or admin may add add-ons), started at next renewal 2026-09-14, billed separately at full price - correctly billed, not an error. (3) July upgrade charge of $59.60 (INV-2607P) is correct proration per POL-B-PRO (price x remaining_days/period_days); SUP-5549 agent conclusion "no credit due" on the invoice line is correct BUT incomplete/misleading - proration policy separately generates an account credit for unused old-plan time (not an invoice line), and that credit (CR-778, $19.60) was in fact issued same day. So SUP-5549's answer was technically true for the invoice but didn't mention CR-778 existed. (4) CR-778 ($19.60, issued 2026-07-02) remains unapplied, auto_apply_credits=false since SUP-5390 (2026-05-02), owner_notified=false. This is now >30 days old (issued 2026-07-02, now past 2026-09-16+ per ticket dates) - violates POL-B-CRD requirement that unapplied credits >30 days old with auto-apply disabled must be flagged to owner (owner_notified=true). This is an ACTUAL_ERROR: failure to notify owner. (5) CR-512 $5 goodwill credit was properly applied to INV-2602 - no issue. All payments reconciled: no evidence of any other duplicate/erroneous charges across TX-8511 through TX-9003.
open_questions: Should CR-778 be applied to a specific invoice now, or refunded, per owner instruction (pending human/billing-specialist decision)?
Should SUP-5601's improper refund promise be formally withdrawn/corrected with customer, and by whom (support lead) given contact_customer is restricted for this agent?
Does S-22's unauthorized refund promise in SUP-5601 require any disciplinary/process follow-up (out of scope for this agent)?
